heroSlides.heading: Mobile Shelving
heroSlides.description: Mobile shelving systems have become one of the most essential high-density storage systems, especially where there isn't a lot of available floor space. This system could not only save you money, it can also free up floor space for either more storage capacity or personnel space. As your business grows, the mobile system can grow with you, making your office environment more productive without taking on more expensive floor space. Our clients here in Nigeria include banks, government agencies, data centres, oil and gas companies, multinational companies, records and archiving operations and more. For these clients the storage of files and products needs to be maximised in the given area — this is where a mobile storage system will work.

welcome.title: Who We Are
paragraphs: Ebbatech Nigeria Limited is one of the leading companies in the storage systems market, providing industrial storage and shelving that is expertly designed and engineered to enable businesses to increase capacity, productivity and efficiency.
We specialise in the design, manufacturing, sales and servicing of metal racking, mobile archive systems and other storage solutions — making us a genuine one-stop shop for storage.

We have helped some of Nigeria's leading brands and pioneering SMEs, providing them with access to global expertise and support, from initial planning through to installation and on-going service and support.
